rules.statement: A booking must be for at least one ticket, as a whole number.
rules.subject: booking tickets

rules.statement: The booking email must look like an email address (contain '@').
rules.subject: booking email

rules.statement: No tickets are sold for a session that is on hold.
rules.subject: session status

evidence.quote: if (session.status === "cancelled") throw new DomainError(409, "session is cancelled");

rules.statement: A cancelled session cannot be booked.
rules.subject: session status

rules.statement: Each requested hire skate quantity must be a whole number of zero or more.
rules.subject: hire skate quantity per size

evidence.quote: if (this.stock.get(size) === 0) throw new DomainError(400, `no hire skates of size ${size}`);

rules.statement: Hire skates can only be requested in sizes the rink stocks (stock is not zero).
rules.subject: hire skate stock per size

rules.statement: A booking cannot hire more skates than it has tickets.
rules.subject: total hire skates in booking

evidence.quote: if (input.tickets > avail.ticketsLeft) throw new DomainError(409, "not enough tickets left");

rules.statement: Tickets requested cannot exceed the tickets still available for the session.
rules.subject: booking tickets

rules.statement: Hire skates requested in each size cannot exceed the skates of that size still available for the session.
rules.subject: hire skate quantity per size

rules.statement: Members can skate free only up to a monthly allowance (MEMBER_FREE_PER_MONTH). Pending and paid member tickets in the session's calendar month, plus the new tickets, must not exceed that allowance.
rules.subject: member free tickets per calendar month

rules.statement: Members pay nothing for tickets; everyone else pays the session price per ticket. Hire skates are charged per pair at the hire price.
rules.subject: booking amount

rules.statement: A booking with nothing to pay is confirmed as paid at once, without a checkout.
rules.subject: booking amount

rules.statement: A pending booking must be paid within the payment window (PAYMENT_WINDOW_MS) after it is created.
rules.subject: booking payment deadline

rules.statement: Once its payment deadline is reached, a pending booking expires and its reservation is released.
rules.subject: pending booking expiry time

rules.statement: A refund is only recorded on a booking that was paid for (status paid or cancelled).
rules.subject: booking status for refund

rules.statement: A payment result (paid or failed) only changes a booking that is still pending, so late payments do not revive expired or released bookings.
rules.subject: booking status for payment result

rules.statement: If the payment checkout cannot be created, the booking is marked failed.
rules.subject: booking status on checkout failure
